label: FR, grave et chaleureux (film d'animation)
design: A deep, warm French male narrator in his fifties, the kind of rich velvety bass voice heard in trailers for big family animated movies: deep and resonant but friendly, with a hint of a smile and a sense of wonder. Perfect native Parisian French diction. Real human voice recorded close to a professional studio microphone, natural breathing and tiny imperfections, relaxed, never robotic, never synthetic.
acting: Read it like the voice-over of a punchy animated movie teaser: deep, calm and confident, short sentences that land on the beat, real pauses between sentences. Slightly mysterious at the start, a knowing smile on « quelqu'un lui répond », energy rising through the list, and a big, warm, unforgettable final line. Never shouting, never rushed, never theatrical; sounds like a real actor in a real studio.
text: Il est partout. Il crie plus fort que les faits. Mais cette fois… quelqu'un lui répond. Quarante marchés, lus chaque matin. Chaque annonce, vue avant qu'elle tombe. Quatre cent soixante-deux idées testées. Six ont survécu. Et avant chaque trade… le feu vert. Jusque dans la crypto. Macro Arsenal. Le onze janvier, le bruit s'arrête.
